description: Track ALFWorld subgoal stages and prevent premature placement or transform skips with soft guidance.

actions.code:
def hook(ctx, nb):
    nb["stage"] = "find_target"
    nb["transform_done"] = False
    nb["last_hint"] = ""
    nb["placed_count"] = 0
    nb["placed_items"] = []
    nb["placed_locations"] = []
    text = "Follow ALFWorld order: find and take the target, apply any required clean heat or cool transform before placing, then put it at the destination. For two-object tasks, leave placed items and fetch another."
    return {"skills": [{"text": text}], "tool_hint": "Do not place a target before its required transform; do not take back an item already at the destination."}
